summary: Iteration 42: tested the PayPal webhook admin card (read-only + permissions only — setup NEVER executed since PayPal is LIVE), the fail-closed /api/webhook/paypal handler, organiser door check-in (backend + mobile 390px UI with manual code entry), the day-before pass reminder cron, and regression on iteration-41 refund/cancellation policy work. Backend: 26/28 pytest checks pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration42_webhook_door_reminder.py, seed /app/backend/tests/i42_seed.py — NOTE: must run with -n 0, the xdist default in pytest.ini makes each worker re-seed). Two genuine defects found: (1) GET /api/me/orders/{id}/cancellation-quote returns 500 for any event booking whose event start date is in the past (StopIteration in cancellation_deduction) — the member cancel sheet never opens, only a generic 'Something went wrong' toast; (2) the door list gates staff on a permission string 'events:manage' that does not exist in PERMISSIONS, so no admin/staff can ever open another organiser's door list. Door flows (valid check-in, counter update, duplicate 'Already used', unknown code) all work on mobile; admin Payments webhook card and Cancellations & refunds + settle dialog render correctly on desktop. All seeded orders/passes cleaned up.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error for event orders whose event already started. cancellation_deduction() computes days = (starts_at - now).days which is negative for past events, and `next(p for d, p in CANCEL_TIERS if days >= d)` raises StopIteration (CANCEL_TIERS lowest tier is d=0). Repro: member arjun.sethi@example.com, order 6a7b73e34a13de566dbd112d (event 18 days in the past) -> 500; UI: /orders -> 'Cancel booking' -> sheet closes with generic error toast. Both of this member's paid event bookings are affected (100%). Fix: clamp days (e.g. max(days, 0)) or add a fallback tier.

Staff fallback is dead code: the check is `"events:manage" not in perms_of(user)` but 'events:manage' is not in PERMISSIONS (only events:view / events:moderate exist), so even the super admin (ALL_PERMISSIONS) gets 403 'That event isn't yours.' on another organiser's event. Docstring promises 'organiser of this event (or staff)'. Use events:view / events:moderate.

ui_bugs.issue: Link is a plain <Link to="/door"> with no event context, so /door always defaults to the first published event. Clicking the door link on the 7th event row (6a7b6458314aa84df39b86f3) landed on 'DIFC Rooftop Jazz' (6a7cc7045fed9266ef613262) — organiser must hunt through a 16-item dropdown. Pass ?event={id} (or router state) and have Door.jsx honour it.

money() is called without the order currency, so it falls back to the global base currency: a USD-charged order (charge_total 100 USD) is displayed as '₹100 paid / ₹30 refundable' in the admin cancellations row and settle dialog. Payments are USD-only now — pass order.currency like CancelBookingDialog does.
No error state: when the quote call fails the sheet closes instantly with a generic toast, giving the member no explanation or retry (currently triggered by the 500 above).

issues: The floating 'Ask Buddy' chat bubble sits on top of the arrivals list and partially covers the status badge of a guest row (e.g. 'valid' at ~x=335) — bump the list's bottom padding / z-index or hide the bubble on /door.

Card renders correctly ('PAYPAL WEBHOOK · LIVE', 'Not connected — PayPal events are ignored until you connect it', notification URL shown). No 'Webhooks registered on this PayPal account' section appears because PayPal returned an empty list with no error — consider showing 'PayPal reports 0 webhooks on this account' instead of nothing.

action_items: Fix cancellation_deduction() StopIteration for past-dated events (500 on /api/me/orders/{id}/cancellation-quote) — blocks member cancellation entirely for those bookings.
Replace the non-existent 'events:manage' permission in GET /api/partner/events/{id}/check-in with events:view/events:moderate so staff can actually open a door list.
Make the partner 'Door check-in' link carry the event id (e.g. /door?event={id}) and have Door.jsx preselect it.
Pass the order currency to money() in Cancellations.jsx (row, settle dialog, refund dialog) — USD orders currently render as ₹.
Give CancelBookingDialog an inline error/retry state instead of closing on quote failure.
Minor: keep the Ask-Buddy bubble off the /door arrivals list on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/admin/paypal/webhook leaks no secrets (verified against PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET / PAYPAL_SANDBOX_CLIENT_SECRET values and key names) and is correctly gated on finance:manage; setup is gated too (member/partner/anon all rejected).

/api/webhook/paypal correctly fails closed: forged PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED (with a real order custom_id) and forged BILLING.SUBSCRIPTION.ACTIVATED both return {'status':'unverified'} and mutate nothing.
send_pass_reminders() marks reminded/reminded_at before sending, so the second cron run is a no-op — verified idempotent; cron requires the bearer secret (401/403 without it).

refund_ceiling()/refund_order() behave: membership refund blocked ('non-refundable'), override without reason blocked, refund above the cancellation quote blocked (quoted 30 of 100), amount > order total blocked, member gets 403.

pytest.ini enables xdist; session-scoped seed fixtures re-run per worker and clobber each other — future iterations should seed via an autouse session fixture keyed per worker or run with -n 0 (documented in the test file).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the i42 suite with `python -m pytest tests/test_iteration42_webhook_door_reminder.py -n 0` (xdist breaks the session seed). Only two tests should fail once the cancellation-quote 500 and the events:manage permission bug are fixed. Camera scanning on /door was not tested (headless); manual code entry covers the same redeem path. Do NOT click [data-testid="paypal-webhook-setup"] or complete a PayPal approval — PAYPAL_ENV=live. Regression items from iteration 41 (policy ceiling on refunds, admin cancellations screen, settle dialog, member cancel sheet for non-event orders) are all working.
rca_of_the_issue: cancellation_deduction(): CANCEL_TIERS = [(7,30),(2,50),(0,100)] is scanned with `next(p for d,p in CANCEL_TIERS if days >= d)`. For an event that already started, timedelta.days is negative, no tier matches, and the bare generator raises StopIteration which FastAPI surfaces as a 500 (traceback confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). The frontend CancelBookingDialog catches the error, toasts 'Something went wrong' and closes, so the member can never cancel. Separately, GET /api/partner/events/{id}/check-in compares against 'events:manage', a permission key absent from PERMISSIONS/ALL_PERMISSIONS, so the staff bypass can never evaluate true.
